Place des Arts launched our Artist in Residence Program in 2014 with the objective of providing no-cost workshops for local SD43 school children to learn through the exploration of various art practices. Thanks, in part, to ongoing funding from the City of Coquitlam, each season, Place des Arts engages several professional artists to lead free workshops at our centre, primarily for local elementary and middle-school field-trip groups. Place des Arts is a stunning multi-use arts facility situated in Heritage Square in the heart of Coquitlam’s historic Maillardville neighbourhood. Located only 25 minutes from downtown Vancouver, Place des Arts boasts a variety of unique rental spaces that include: Leonore Peyton Salon, Atrium, Renaissance Room, dance studio, four multi-purpose classrooms and nine music studios. The centre provides an ideal setting to hold a wide range of events including meetings, award ceremonies, corporate functions, workshops, recitals, festivals and performances.
